paragraph: A man named Joshua Service rides the rails through Queens like anyone else. He saw a hillside where people had left piles of garbage beside the tracks. Most riders walk past. He stopped. He took out his phone and filmed the dumping site so others could see what had happened there. Someone with that name chose to be the one who noticed.

seed.summary: It’s not uncommon to walk past litter in a major city: what’s uncommon is stopping to do something about it. Yet it wasn’t just litter that Queens resident Joshua Service walked past on a recent rail commute, but a spontaneous dumping site. Mr. Service whipped out his phone and recorded a video of the piles
seed.sourceTitle: Man Named ‘Service’ Cleans Up NYC Dumping Site on His Own Initiative
